text: Nebius reported Q3 revenue of $980.8 million, up 571% year over year, and a $37.5 million net loss. Shares fell 16%. Management expects 2026 revenue near $3 billion and raised planned capital expenditures to $27 billion for 2026 and $40-$45 billion for 2027.

meta.note: Revenue and losses are reported results; capital spending and revenue outlooks remain management projections.
